rodadas.destaque: How old is Júlia?
rodadas.explica: "I'm 13 years old" = tenho 13 anos. O 10 é a idade do irmão.
rodadas.texto: Hi! My name is Júlia. I'm 13 years old and I live in Fortaleza, Brazil. I have one brother, Pedro. He is 10. I love music and I play the guitar. My favorite food is pizza, but I don't like fish. On Saturdays, I go to the beach with my family.

rodadas.destaque: What kind of text is this?
rodadas.explica: "Come to my birthday party!": é um convite (invitation).
rodadas.texto:
Dear Lucas,
Come to my birthday party!
Date: Saturday, May 10th
Time: 3 p.m. to 7 p.m.
Place: 25 Green Street
Please bring your swimsuit. We're going to have a pool party!
See you there,
Marina

rodadas.destaque: What time does the party start?
rodadas.explica: "3 p.m. to 7 p.m.": começa às 15h e termina às 19h.

rodadas.destaque: Why couldn't Tom play soccer?
rodadas.explica: "It was raining a lot" = estava chovendo muito.
rodadas.texto: Tom wanted to play soccer in the park after school. But when he looked out of the window, it was raining a lot. He was very sad. Then his mother had an idea: "Let's make a pizza!" They cooked together, and Tom forgot about the rain.

rodadas.destaque: How did Tom feel at first?
rodadas.explica: "He was very sad" = ele ficou muito triste.

rodadas.destaque: Why can't Bia go to the party?
rodadas.explica: "I have a test tomorrow" = tenho prova amanhã.

Bia: Hi! I can't. I have a test tomorrow. 😩
Ana: Oh no! What subject?
Bia: Math. 📐
Ana: Good luck! Let's meet on Saturday?
Bia: Sure! See you on Saturday! 😊
